placements.title: Technical architecture and infrastructure decisions
placements.theme: The organization's technical architecture evolves through deliberate platform and infrastructure changes.

placements.title: Analytics pipeline migrates from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB
placements.theme: The analytics pipeline is moving to QuantumDB to achieve 10x query performance and lower licensing costs, targeting Q3 2026.
placements.why: All five segments cohere around the single thematic direction of migrating the analytics database: src-1 and src-3 declare the migration, src-2 and src-4 provide the performance and cost justification, and src-5 commits to the Q3 2026 timeline. The performance figures and timeline are evidence for the migration theme, not standalone leaves.
